title: Weird holy hell in handbasket
content: I’m usually shopping in a dream at some place. Whether it’s like a bodega off the dang side of the road that has like food in the food warmer that I look at, but I know I don’t want. Or a very overpacked retail big box store that’s impossible to look for what I need because there’s so much stuff. Or I’m looking through at the mall of clothes I would’ve bought in the 1990s and I’m usually trying to find something in particular but I can never find it.
